full_transcript_playback.text: Hey, Magic Mike here from Ride Electric. I can help you with workshop updates, bookings, repairs and product questions. So, What are you after today?
I just wanna know about the FatFish OG. I wanted to know a little bit about, um...

[Patient] Great choice. For your Fatfish OG, always check the battery contacts before fitting, keep the chain lubricated, and avoid riding in rain or extreme heat. Store the battery at50 to70 percent charge if not in use for long periods. Let me know if you'd like details on servicing or warranty.
Yeah, I'd like to know how do I, um, how do I just, yeah, get the brakes back nice and tight and, uh, what, what tools do I need to do that, you know?

[Patient] For tightening your brakes, you'll need a5mm Allen key and a torque wrench. First, check the brake caliper bolts—tighten them to8 Newton metres. Then, adjust the brake pads so they’re evenly aligned with the rotor. Make sure not to over-tighten the handlebar levers. If you're unsure, we recommend a professional check.
[Excitedly] Glad I could help! If you need anything else on your Fatfish OG, just give me a shout. Ride safe!
Hey there, Troy. How can I help you today?
